bullets.text: Kotak: Accenture FY27 guide 3-6% includes 2-2.5% inorganic, so organic only 0.5-4%; no AI-deflation hit baked in, supporting 12-13x for Tier-1 Indian IT.
bullets.source: Kotak — [Kotak] IT Services: Healthy beat and a reasonable guidance

detail.summary: Accenture's 4QFY26 beat (7% lc vs 1-5% guide) leaned on transitory factors: short-cycle deals, faster ramp-ups and Federal acquisitions. Kotak sees no demand change for Indian IT, but reads the absence of any AI-driven revenue deflation in guidance as a positive.
points: Q4 bookings US$22.2bn, +5% lc; pricing lower in many areas
US$5bn M&A, US$5.5bn buybacks planned in FY27

bullets.text: US September payrolls +29k vs 89k consensus, unemployment 4.2%; India 10Y G-sec up to 7.21% and Brent at US$126.9/bbl on the week.
bullets.source: Kotak — [Kotak] Economy Tracker: Markets Update; IN August INR REER; ... US September labor data

detail.summary: Weekly macro tracker: Indian rates sold off across the curve while liquidity stayed in surplus, and equities fell about 3% across caps. August activity data were firm (IIP 8%, GST +14.7%) while the RBI's forward book short widened sharply.
points: RBI forward book net short US$200bn end-Aug (US$137bn end-Jul)

bullets.text: PhillipCapital: Nifty's eighth straight weekly fall (-3.15% to 22,421) breached 23,000; 21,900 is the 'mother support' and trendline from March 2024 lows.
bullets.source: PhillipCapital — DETAILED ANALYSIS of BREAKOUT AND BREAKDOWN STOCKS (In F&O segment) THIS WEEK - week ending 3 Oct 2026

detail.summary: Technical wrap: a decisive break of 21,900 would turn the two-year consolidation bearish, with a loose head-and-shoulders on the monthly line chart. Mid and small caps tracked the index rather than leading it lower, and the IT index was the relative outperformer of the week.
points: F&O breakout/breakdown list in attached xlsx
